headings.strategy: Friendly but clinical, providing trust. No Inter.

body.strategy: High legibility for medical data and dense information on mobile.

grids.spacing: Generous spacing. p-6 or p-8 for card interiors to prevent text collision.

layouts.page_wrapper: max-w-7xl mx-auto px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8 py-8
layouts.header: sticky top-0 z-50 bg-white/90 backdrop-blur-xl border-b border-slate-200
layouts.timeline: vertical line with overlapping circular nodes. Green/Amber/Red nodes based on vaccine status.

visual_enhancers.shadows: Ambient and soft. Avoid harsh, tight shadows.
visual_enhancers.borders: 1px solid very light gray (slate-200) to ground floating elements.
visual_enhancers.surface_strategy: Solid Flat Surfaces. Do NOT use glassmorphism for medical data cards to ensure maximum clarity and accessibility. Glassmorphism only allowed for the top sticky nav.

components.buttons: Pill-shaped (rounded-full). Min h-12 for touch targets on mobile. Active state: scale-95.
components.inputs: h-12, rounded-xl, border-slate-300 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-primary/20 focus:border-primary.
components.badges: rounded-full px-3 py-1 text-xs font-semibold for statuses.
components.skeleton: Pulse animation with rounded-2xl or rounded-full matching the replaced content.
components.tabs: Pill-shaped segmented control style instead of standard underline, ensuring clear active state.

motion.route_transitions: Fade in with subtle slide up (y: 10 to y: 0) using framer-motion.
motion.interactions: Hover states on cards (-translate-y-1 + enhanced shadow). Tap states on mobile (scale-95).
motion.success_state: Animated checkmark path drawing + scale pulse for vaccination entry success.

accessibility.contrast: Strict WCAG AA for all medical text. Ensure status text (green/amber/red) has minimum 4.5:1 ratio against its background.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST include data-testid attribute.

media.icons: lucide-react for clinical, clean, geometric icons. 1.5px stroke width.

image_urls.description: Father hugging laughing young daughter. Use for Parent Role Selection card or Parent Onboarding.
Female doctor with stethoscope. Use for Doctor Role Selection card or Doctor Onboarding.
Abstract light blue flowing lines. Use as a subtle background for the login/auth screens.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a mobile-first PWA, optimized for touch (large buttons, bottom sheets).
Use Manrope for headings and DM Sans for body. Do not use Inter.
Implement the UI with standard JS/JSX (.js or .jsx extensions, NOT .tsx as per the project requirements).
Implement the UI with Shadcn components but heavily customize them. Cards should be rounded-2xl to rounded-3xl with very soft shadows.
Use framer-motion for route transitions and the success checkmark animation when a doctor records a vaccine.
Ensure the vaccination timeline clearly visualizes India's UIP schedule grouped by age milestones (Birth, 6 weeks, etc.) with explicit green/amber/red status colors.
Ensure `data-testid` is added to all form inputs, buttons, and clickable cards.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Avoid generic 'AI slop' aesthetic. Create depth with layered elements and z-index hierarchy.
Do NOT use dark colors as gradients.
DO NOT apply universal transitions (e.g., transition: all). Add transitions to specific properties.
DO NOT center align the main app container.
Every interaction needs micro-animations (hover, active, focus states).
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable.
GENERAL UI UX DESIGN GUIDELINES: Prioritize optical alignment over geometrical alignment.
Forms should not use native select/date elements; use customized Shadcn equivalents.
Use solid, flat surfaces for data-heavy sections (like medical records) to prevent visual refraction and maintain accessibility.
Never use fully transparent backgrounds under text.
